lead: Two queue cases in `live_config.rs` can fail under `bun nv verify`'s full load with "the reload did not name … as applied: invalidated: 0".
body: `Server::reload` saves `nvs.toml` before it runs `nvs ctl reload`, and the server's own check (`crate::control::check`) can publish the saved file first, leaving the ctl report nothing to apply. Re-run `bun nv verify` before suspecting your change: it re-runs only the failed binary.
